payload.claim: `write_findings`'s docstring cites `(`CONTEXT.md`, design section 4)` for the 'backlog pool' object it builds, but this spec's own Out of scope section states plainly that 'CONTEXT.md has no entry for the backlog pool or findings.json.' Citing CONTEXT.md beside the term it explicitly disclaims risks sending a reader to CONTEXT.md looking for a definition that was never written there.
